EndPage.title: We are completing your installation...
EndPage.postInstallDescription: Please check that all your emulators has been installed. If an emulator or tool failed to install, run a Custom Reset or install the emulator using the Manage Emulators page.
EndPage.readBeforeDescription:
EmuDeck is designed to work using Steam input, you need to launch the games using Steam after adding them with Steam Rom Manager, same thing with the Emulators, EmulationStation or Pegasus, otherwise the controls and hotkeys won't work.
Apps like DeckTools or Handheld Companion might break controls too in some cases.
Make sure your handheld is on GamePad mode at all times, not on Desktop or Auto.
If you want to use other Frontends like Playnite you will need to activate Steam Input on the Desktop as shown on the video and keep Steam open in the background at all times.

DeckyRomLauncherPage.intro: Retro Library is a plugin that allows you to have a second Steam Library with only your roms so they are not mixed up with your Steam games.
DeckyRomLauncherPage.autoDetect: All games and artwork are detected automatically.
DeckyRomLauncherPage.title: Configure Retro Library

RemotePlayWhateverPage.intro: Play with your friends both locally and over the internet. More info on this tool
RemotePlayWhateverPage.step1: First click on install RemotePlayWhatever, this will install it and open Steam Rom Manager to add its shorcut to Steam
RemotePlayWhateverPage.step2: When you are in gaming mode go to the Emulator collection and launch RemotePlayWhatever, invite your Steam Friend, go back to your library using the STEAM button, open your game from EmulationStation and start playing!
RemotePlayWhateverPage.beta: This app is on beta, so sometimes it does not work 100% fine, expect some crashes and issues with the sound. At the moment launching games outside EmulationStation is not supported.
RemotePlayWhateverPage.title: Multiplayer with RemotePlayWhatever - Beta
